reached.span: Alexanarch, 20 October–3 November 2026: From the preservation of thought to the preservation of its capacity to change

atoms.span: The homepage's founding account identifies the precipitating event as Zenodo's termination of access to approximately 870 deposits representing 1,817 DOIs in June 2026.

It is becoming an attempt to construct the conditions for an intellectual institution that can preserve, transmit, criticize and generate knowledge without allowing the mechanisms of transmission to silently determine what knowledge is.
Its initial problem is the preservation of intellectual work against the arbitrary power of custodians.
There is a direct connection here to the Obelus Principle: judgment follows reading, and a judgment must retain the reason for which it was made.
The AXN identifier system attempts to make identity dependent on the content rather than on the continued goodwill of one platform.

Lineage absent: Zenodotus and Alexandria are not reached (Zenodo is). Deposit chain absent: versioning is named for one work (#1726, v0.10) and distributed custody for the Fleet and the Hugging Face datasets; supersession and restoration as the record's chain are not given.
